title: Agent
description: One Devin session, wrapped in a role. Rendered as a card in AgentGrid and a node in AgentGraph.

id.description: Our id for the agent, stable across session restarts.

session_id.description: Devin's own session id. Null until the session is created.

session_url.description: Deep link to the Devin session, shown on the card so judges can click through.

title.description: Human label, e.g. 'Debug Eng #2 - gripper slip cluster'.

task.description: One-line statement of what this agent was dispatched to do.

iteration.description: Fix/verify attempts consumed. Capped by MAX_AGENT_ITERATIONS.

cluster_id.description: Failure cluster this agent owns, for investigator/fixer roles.

scenario_ids.description: Scenarios in scope for this agent.

parent_agent_id.description: Agent that spawned this one, e.g. investigator -> fixer handoff.

last_activity.description: Most recent line from the Devin transcript, for the live 'what is it doing' ticker.

role.description: Position on the simulated engineering team. See docs/AGENT_ROLES.md.
